title: Smoked Slovakian Long Bratwurst Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful dish combining traditional Slovakian sausage with a sweet and savory bake. Gluten-free and perfect for a comforting dinner.

ingredients.name: Smoked Slovakian Long Bratwurst
ingredients.notes: you can find Slovakian sausage at most specialty stores or online

ingredients.name: Long
ingredients.notes: this is likely referring to the type of potato, 'long' is a variety

instructions: Slice the long bratwurst into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
Peel and chop the onion and garlic, then sauté them in a pan until softened.
Add the sliced bratwurst to the pan and cook until browned.
In a separate bowl, mix the bake, vanilla, salt, and pepper.
Cut the long potatoes into 1-inch pieces and add them to the bowl with the bake mixture.
Combine the cooked bratwurst mixture with the potato mixture and stir until well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
